proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9209.1 *bāppa gives Nepali/Maithili bāp, Oriya bāpa and regional bāpū father. Danuwar bapo preserves the p-bearing nursery-word branch, with its final vowel retained, rather than the separate bābba branch. Exact survey response: bapo.
